Experience in independent hardware maintenance, services delivery A service-oriented, open mindset Thrive in a fast-paced collaborative environment. Team player, openness towards different cultures. Customer-centric with excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Must have experience in a 2nd line support role with a background in general support and operations. Experience of working with and troubleshooting BGP . Hands-on experience of upgrading Firmware of Switches, Routers, Firewalls and Wifi/Wireless access points. Knowledge and experience of ticketing/incident management systems (e.g ServiceNow, Zendesk, or HaloITSM) Understanding of ITIL best practices. (ITIL Foundations certification desirable). Flexibility to work in any shift pattern covering nights, weekends (BH) including 24 x 7 is essential
